description: This PHP source file defines the DateTimeResult class, which extends the built-in DateTime class to add custom parsing and formatting methods for handling ISO 8601 timestamps with nanosecond precision, used within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: Aws\Api\DateTimeResult
classes.description: An extension of PHP's DateTime class that provides additional methods for parsing ISO 8601 timestamps with nanosecond precision, converting from epoch, and JSON serialization to improve compatibility with AWS service responses.

methods.name: fromEpoch
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult object from a UNIX timestamp, supporting subsecond precision where available.

methods.name: fromISO8601
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult object from an ISO 8601 formatted timestamp, adjusting for nanosecond precision in older PHP versions.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeResult object from an arbitrary timestamp, choosing between ISO 8601 and epoch formats based on input and expected format.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the ISO 8601 string representation of the date, useful for serializing the object as a string.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the DateTimeResult object to a JSON-compatible ISO 8601 date string.
